backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, Nakshatra CRUD operations with role-based access control (admin/user permissions), blob storage for images, and export/import functionality for data migration between canisters.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features for syncing data from live to draft canister, including the sync utility hook, UI button component, and status display with high confidence test coverage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing the React application structure, including routing, Nakshatra display/editing, astronomical calculations for pada determination, admin functionality, and sync management features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for a cosmic aesthetic with purple/violet primary colors and cyan accents.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Star Field Explorer application with viewport meta tag and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, Nakshatra details, and admin pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider for dark mode and including toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that displays PasscodeEntry for unauthenticated users and renders protected admin content for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogoutButto: Logout button component that clears passcode authentication, Internet Identity session, and React Query cache while displaying success toast notification.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Expandable banner displaying the current Nakshatra with Moon position, pada number, lunar climate description, and karmic lesson, with clickable link to detail page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Caffeine.ai attribution link including UTM parameters and dynamic copyright year display.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with Star Field Explorer branding, Moon icon, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin sections.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing consistent header, footer, and main content structure using React Router's Outlet for nested routes.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Displays a grid of all 27 Nakshatras as clickable cards with images, highlighting the current Nakshatra based on the Moon's position. Fetches Nakshatra data and images from the backend, showing loading states during initialization.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Provides an image upload component with 4:5 aspect ratio validation, preview functionality, and progress indication. Converts uploaded files to Uint8Array for backend storage.
frontend/src/components/PasscodeEntry.ts: Renders an admin authentication form that validates a passcode before proceeding to Internet Identity authentication. Shows loading states during the authentication process.
frontend/src/components/SyncFromLiveButt: Provides a button with confirmation dialog to sync all draft Nakshatra data and images from the live production environment. Displays success/error toasts after sync completion.
frontend/src/components/SyncStatusDispla: Displays the last sync timestamp with relative time formatting and visual indicators for sync freshness. Warns when data is over 24 hours old and updates every minute.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes due to identity updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Provides the current Nakshatra based on the Moon's position, automatically refreshing every 5 minutes to keep the data current.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing login state, identity persistence, and authentication lifecycle with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: Provides a React Query mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data, including optional image replacement, with automatic query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasscodeAuth.ts: Manages passcode-based authentication with Internet Identity integration, using sessionStorage and custom events for cross-component state synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching Nakshatras and images with error transformation, initialization error detection, and exponential backoff retry logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncFromLive.ts: Provides a mutation hook to sync Nakshatra and image data from a live canister to a draft canister, with progress tracking and localStorage-based sync timestamp management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming (colors, radius, charts) in both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing individual Nakshatra entries with form fields for all properties, image upload support, and mutation-based updates with navigation on success.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying all Nakshatras in a grid with images, edit buttons, sync functionality, and loading/error states with retry logic.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page that displays an introduction to Nakshatras, the current Nakshatra banner, and a grid of all 27 Nakshatras. Handles loading and error states for backend canister initialization with retry logic.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for individual Nakshatras showing comprehensive information including deity, symbol, ruling planet, qualities, and four pada subdivisions. Fetches data from backend canister with fallback to local pada data, displays images, and highlights if the Nakshatra is currently active.
frontend/src/utils/canisterConfig.ts: Configuration utilities for managing live and draft canister IDs from environment variables. Provides validation and dynamic actor creation for the live canister using ICP SDK.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Core astronomical calculation engine that computes the Moon's ecliptic longitude using Julian Day and determines the current Nakshatra and pada. Defines the 27 Nakshatras with their degree ranges and provides lookup functions.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Static data defining detailed descriptions for each of the 108 padas (4 per Nakshatra), including degree ranges, navamsa signs, titles, and extensive interpretive text. Serves as fallback when backend data is unavailable.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities that work with both standard query strings and hash-based routing. Provides session storage integration for persisting parameters like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with container settings, border radius variables, custom animations for accordions, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file for Star Field Explorer astrology app tracking features for live-to-draft data synchronization system with automatic nakshatra text and image syncing, including 3 existing features and 5 pending feature requests for backend export/import functions.
